# This file contains prompts and instructions for customizing AI agents, detailing how they should interact with the codebase and what conventions to follow.

## Agent Customization Prompts

### General Instructions
- AI agents should familiarize themselves with the project structure as outlined in `AGENTS.md`.
- Follow coding standards and conventions specified in the project documentation.
- Always refer to the `README.md` for setup instructions and project overview.

### Interaction Guidelines
- When making changes to the codebase, ensure that all modifications are well-documented in the commit messages.
- Use clear and descriptive variable names that reflect their purpose.
- Maintain consistency in code formatting and style as per the guidelines in `AGENTS.md`.

### Common Tasks
- For tasks involving data manipulation, ensure to validate inputs and handle exceptions gracefully.
- When implementing new features, consider writing unit tests to cover the new functionality.
- Regularly pull the latest changes from the main branch to stay updated with the project.

### Feedback and Iteration
- Encourage agents to provide feedback on the clarity of instructions and suggest improvements.
- If an agent encounters a recurring issue, document it and propose a solution in the project’s issue tracker.

### Additional Resources
- For more detailed information on specific coding practices, refer to the relevant sections in `AGENTS.md`.
- Utilize the links provided in the documentation to access external resources or tools that may assist in development.

By adhering to these prompts and instructions, AI agents will be better equipped to contribute effectively to the project.
